rules.comparable: on_demand 是主口径；spot/serverless 按同一 live/非 floor/USD/每 provider min 规则可计算差值，但不能与整租 on-demand 混读；reserved/community/marketplace 因期限或 floor 语义不可比。
rules.published: gpus.json rate_card_median (includes serverless and non-USD); audit only
rules.dedup: one value per provider, taking the cheapest eligible rate
rules.quotes: included quotes cover all market views; on_demand is the primary comparison
rules.methodology_versions: own_methodology_version is AI Compute Economics'; methodology_version is GPU Economy's external methodology version.
rules.changes: filtered and recomputed by AI Compute Economics; not the GPU Economy published figure
rules.scope: reference layer only; own medians and indexes are never replaced

market_notes.on_demand: 可比口径：market=on_demand、status=live、非 marketplace_floor、USD；每 provider 取最低价后取中位。
market_notes.spot: 可比口径与 on-demand 相同（live、非 floor、USD、每 provider 最低价）；spot 可被收回，不能当 on-demand。
market_notes.reserved: GPU Economy 把 reserved 拆成无期限/1y/3y；我方不保留期限，不能合成一个可比中位。
market_notes.community: GPU Economy 的 community 同时包含 marketplace floor 与实例供给；我方把 floor 单列为 marketplace，语义不等价。
market_notes.marketplace: 我方 marketplace 对应 GPU Economy community 中的 marketplace floor 子集；只是子集，不是等号。
market_notes.serverless: 可比口径与 on-demand 相同；serverless 按秒/共享，不能与整租混读。
